verses.verse:
योगेश्वरस्य कृष्णस्य प्रेरणा यादृशी भवेत।
मादृशाम् तादृशी बुद्धिर्जनानाम् कर्मवर्त्मनि।।११।।
verses.text: As the inspiration of Kṛṣṇa, lord of yoga, may be, so is the understanding of people like me on the path of action.

commentary.text: I have no importance in writing this work, because the Lord's inspiration, working through circumstances, gets done by each person whatever work it wants done by them. So first of all I have to consider which metal is how useful for the bānsurī.

subsection.title: The Kinds of Bānsurī and Suitable Materials
